Chapter 613: Chapter 37: Inconceivable News (Please Subscribe)_2

“`

Such opportunities are invariably related to time, and the Ancient God Ancestor knew quite a few of them, like “Eternal Dream,” “Land Beyond,” and so on.

By utilizing exaggerated time flow rates, one achieves a leap in personal strength in a short period of time.

This kind of method is not a secret among the Ninth Rank and Eleventh Rank circles in the Cosmic Starry Skies; even more so for the peak clans. Otherwise, why would human civilization, which has only emerged from its home planet for just over two million years, have produced so many terrifying powerhouses?

Over two million years is merely the time flow rate of the Main Universe; as for those Eleventh Rank powerhouses of human civilization, how many years they have actually experienced is another matter.

But no matter how much time flow rate one experiences, some things cannot be achieved just by having enough time.

...

For example, creating one hundred million Spatial Layers at Ninth Rank—even if you gave a genius like Hunyi a hundred million or a billion years, it would still be impossible to achieve.

And once there is a difference between the time flow rate and that of the Main World, the perception of the Great Dao’s rules becomes infinitely vague.

Without the understanding of the Space Rules of the Main Universe, how can one possibly create Spatial Layers out of thin air? It’s basically impossible.

“Ancestor…” Maduo Traveler was also profoundly shaken inside. The Ancient God Ancestor had been born countless tens of thousands of years ago, during which he even “sponsored” two Supreme Beings who had not yet grown up.

He had seen countless peerless and defying geniuses and many unique lives that were the only ones of their kind in the universe.

Yet now, the Ancestor actually said that the Galaxy Master has the strongest innate talent he’s ever seen?

“Ancestor, are you saying that the Galaxy Master could become a Supreme Being?” Maduo Traveler asked with a trembling soul. A Supreme Being? He had just crossed fists with the Galaxy Master not long ago.

“It’s not that simple.” The Ancient God Ancestor shook his head as he spoke.

A Supreme Being is not something that can be achieved through talent and innate ability alone; it also requires various external factors and, crucially, luck.

The Ancient God Ancestor had lived through countless long years, and the two still-growing Supreme Beings he had supported did not have such heaven-defying innate abilities, less so than many special beings.

Yet, in the end, they still stood at the pinnacle of the universe.

“But at least, the Galaxy Master has a greater hope of becoming a Supreme Being than most other beings,” said the Ancient God Ancestor.

While talent and innate ability might not help much in becoming a Supreme Being, they do grant powerful strength. With such strength, one can gain more resources and opportunities, which do help in becoming a Supreme Being.

“However…” The Ancient God Ancestor seemed to think of something, and a trace of heartache appeared on his face, “With such a good opportunity, how could you not seize it?”

Maduo, holding the “Time Black Hole” capable of trapping a special Ninth Rank being, could have proactively rescued the Galaxy Master before he made his move.

Even if the Galaxy Master did not need saving, at the very least, he could have owed Maduo a favor.

“Ancestor, it was you who told me to take action at the critical moment,” Maduo Traveler said, shrinking his head and speaking somewhat aggrieved.

“Can’t you judge some things for yourself?” The Ancient God Ancestor glanced at Maduo Traveler.

…

Human civilization, Virtual World.

Within a private Virtual World.

Several Ninth Rank Evolvers gathered here, engaging in casual conversation.

How strong is the Spirit Will of a Ninth Rank Evolver? Multitasking with ease, sending a strand of will into the Virtual World for relaxation, without affecting what they were doing.

“That Hunyi of the Tianyu Clan is too shameless. Who knows how many tens of thousands of years he has cultivated, and he specifically went to hunt down the Galactic Star Master,” said several Ninth Ranks whose avatars entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

The content of their conversation mostly concerned matters occurring within the Secret Realm.

“It’s a pity that several of the special Ninth Ranks of our human civilization are too far away and can’t make it over in a short time,” sighed a Ninth Rank Evolver.

The Xuanhuang Secret Realm is vast, and it suppresses any teleportation or instant movement methods, which results in low rescue efficiency.

“Duoke has already spoken out. He said that if anything happens to the Galactic Star Master, he will go all out to hunt down the Ninth Rank of the Tianyu Clan for the next duration the Secret Realm is open,” said a third Ninth Rank.

Duoke is the strongest Ninth Rank Evolver of the human civilization in this era, having opened nearly forty million Spatial Layers, and his strength is even above Hunyi’s.

If Duoke were to give up opportunities within the Secret Realm to chase down the Ninth Rank powerhouses of the Tianyu Clan, it would be a major event. Those Ninth Rank lives of the Tianyu Clan would certainly be terrified.

But the few Evolvers didn’t think Hunyi would compromise. To pay the price of some ordinary Ninth Rank Tianyu beings in exchange for detaining Duoke, the most powerful Ninth Rank of human civilization, was not too much of a loss. Moreover, they could even kill the Galactic Star Master once.

“However, even if the Galactic Star Master dies, at most he would lose an avatar and forgo the chance in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, which is still acceptable,” said the first Ninth Rank Evolver to speak.

These old fellows wanted to use the opportunities within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm to attempt to go one step further.

But the Galactic Star Master is still young, and the Xuanhuang Secret Realm isn’t essential for him.

“What I’m worried about is that this incident may change the Galactic Star Master’s mindset,” another Evolver said with a serious tone.

Upon hearing this,

the brows of the other Ninth Ranks slightly furrowed.

Indeed.

If it were them,

being killed by Hunyi and losing an avatar wouldn’t affect them in the slightest.

“`

“`

But the Galaxy Master? Too young, and has experienced too few things, hardly having faced any setbacks.

This kind of unparalleled prodigy, normally unstoppable, once obstructed, the impact will not be small.

Such examples are not nonexistent in the history of human civilization, although the probability is not large, but the Galaxy Master is too important to human civilization.

“I hope the Galaxy Master won’t be affected by the killing of his avatar…”

The last Ninth Rank Evolver was just about to speak.

Suddenly.

Several Evolvers present almost received a message at the same time.

“The Galaxy Master counter killed Hunyi?”

“And did so with an absolute advantage? Hunyi didn’t even dare to engage, directly self-destructing that avatar?”

“How is this possible?”

The Ninth Rank Evolvers blinked, some not quite catching up.

If it weren’t for the fact that they received this message simultaneously and it was confirmed multiple times, they would have thought it was a joke.

“The Galaxy Master…”

After a long while, the Ninth Rank Evolvers recovered from the shock, they looked at each other, their astonishment evident in their expressions.

It was too incredible.

How did the Galaxy Master manage to do it?

…

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Duoke, who was rapidly moving through the heavy Spatial Layers, suddenly stopped.

He was the strongest Ninth Rank life form of the human civilization in this era, intending to attempt a rescue of the Galaxy Master.

Although he wasn’t very hopeful, one always has to try.

But now?

Duoke’s expression was somewhat shocked.

“The Galaxy Master doesn’t need my rescue?”

“Did Hunyi perish at the hands of the Galaxy Master?”

Duoke was a bit stunned; as a special Ninth Rank himself, he had clashed with Hunyi more than once.

Therefore, Duoke was well aware of Hunyi’s strength, it was possible for him to defeat Hunyi, but to kill Hunyi? Even to force Hunyi into self-destructing voluntarily?

At least in Duoke’s mind, unless a Tenth Rank powerhouse intervened, it seemed unlikely that any Ninth Rank could achieve this.

“Has the Galaxy Master broken through to Tenth Rank?” Duoke speculated internally, but immediately dismissed this possibility.

This was the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, which rejects any life form above and including Tenth Rank.

If the Galaxy Master was an ordinary Tenth Rank, with the transformation of his Life Essence, he would be repelled by the Xuanhuang Secret Realm immediately.

“Not Tenth Rank…” Duoke found it hard to believe, unable to conceive how exactly the Galaxy Master achieved all this with his strength.

…

The events in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm naturally couldn’t be kept secret, and the Myriad Clans in the Cosmic Starry Skies learned of it at the first instance.

“The Galaxy Master, it’s always the Galaxy Master, when he was at Eighth Layer, he could kill those unbeatable Eighths like butchering chickens. Now that he’s Ninth Rank, is he going after those special Ninth Ranks too?”

“Could it be that the Galaxy Master is the direct descendant of a Supreme Being from human civilization? No, even if he were the offspring of a Supreme Being, it shouldn’t be this monstrous.”

“Too amazing, the Galaxy Master is just over a hundred years old, right?”

…

The many Clans found it incredible, the Galaxy Master had already created enough miracles, but who would have thought that shortly after stepping into Ninth Rank, he would tear apart the myth of the special Ninth Ranks.

Many Clans began to sense subtly that in the long years to come, the shadow of the Galaxy Master would loom in the minds of every Ninth Rank powerhouse.

…..

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan was also aware that his killing of Hunyi would have a great impact on the Ten Thousand Universe Races.

But backed by human civilization, there was no need to conceal strength at every turn; moreover, Lin Yuan’s killing of Hunyi was far from his full effort, having mobilized less than two hundred million Spatial Layers, far short of the over two billion Spatial Layers.

Whoosh.

With a thought from Lin Yuan.

A ‘bell-shaped’ secret treasure appeared before him, emanating strands of mysterious aura.
